Date: Wed, 15 Mar 2028 01:32:05 -07:00
Subject: StablePoint — exec bulletin and interim status (post-bridge)

Summary (post 10:00 PT bridge):
- Impact: StablePoint observed p95 latency increases and a customer-facing error-rate peak at ~09:05 PT; mitigation reduced error-rate from 8% -> 1.1% by 10:25 PT.
- Root cause (prelim): sudden upstream traffic pattern change exacerbated model kv-cache churn and pushed primary inference runtime into a pathological batching regime; combined with a stale kernel selection on one pool node.
- Actions completed:
  - 30% traffic shift to quantized fallback for heavy tail flows (immediate relief)
  - Full reprovision of affected pool with updated kernel selection (completed 10:15 PT)
  - Short-term cache warmers enabled for StablePoint prefixes (reduced kv misses)
  - Customer-engaged: StablePoint instituted edge rate-limits for heavy B2B flows while we validate stability
- Next steps and asks:
  - Rishi: run a targeted stress + kernel-selection regression test across pools (ETA 6h)
  - Vivek: add telemetry flags to capture batch-size distribution for 72h window (ETA 2h)
  - Marissa: finalize postmortem draft and customer-facing RCA within 24h; include clear mitigations and a timeline for permanent fixes
  - Laura: schedule a follow-up exec check-in tomorrow 09:30 PT; prepare the customer impact slide (SLO violations, affected endpoints, financial exposure)

Attachments: runbook-stablepoint-response-v2.pdf, metrics-snapshot-20280314.png
Related: HUBSPOT-4321

Status: Stabilized — monitoring closely; customer satisfied with interim mitigations and requested RCA.

Olga Petrov
